name: @localdrop/ios
description: LocalDrop iPhone app: backs up photos and videos to a Windows PC over local Wi-Fi

scripts.build:debug: cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace LocalDrop.xcworkspace -scheme LocalDrop -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -derivedDataPath build
scripts.build:release: cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace LocalDrop.xcworkspace -scheme LocalDrop -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -derivedDataPath build
